digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend comment sanitization
propositions: rebar hardcodes comment truncation at 32767 chars while Jira Data Center's jira.text.field.character.limit is admin-configurable (default 32767, range 0 to 2147483647)
when a DC administrator raises or removes the comment character limit, rebar silently truncates comments that the instance would accept, causing permanent divergence between local and remote bodies
the constant WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT is incorrectly attributed to Cloud comment limits rather than DC's jira.text.field.character.limit property, reversing actual causality
sanitize_comment couples to the description fitter (fit_outbound) creating a latent trap where future description fitter changes could retarget comment truncation
comment_max_chars is now configurable via [tool.rebar.reconciler].comment_max_chars with default 32767, decoupled from the description fitter and cited to JRASERVER-28519
